title: Think Like a Person Before Responding: A Multi-Faceted Evaluation of Persona-Guided LLMs for Countering Hate Speech
reasoning: The paper includes 'ethical robustness' and 'ethical risk' as one of its four core evaluation dimensions. It quantitatively benchmarks the potential for LLMs to generate hateful content (moral/ethical safety) using the MetaHateBERT model, which constitutes a significant component of the evaluation rather than just a brief ethical considerations section.
